violations.text: Several food items in the refrigerator were observed above 41 degrees Fahrenheit: Cheese Sticks in the bottom drawer of the refrigerator were observed held at 60 degrees F Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Cheese sticks were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection. (Per the PIC, food items were removed from the refrigerator for organization and prep prior to inspection.) Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2026

Ceiling tiles in the kitchen area were observed stained/cracked and in need of replacement. Ceiling tiles in a kitchen/food service area are to be smooth durable, easily cleanable (currently porous tiles). Ceiling tiles are to be replaced with smooth, durable, easily cleanable tiles. New Violation. Correct By: 01/31/2027

At the time of inspection, food items were delivered from mother school (Warwick Veteran's Middle School). Leafy Greens, Spinach for salads, were observed to be delivered at 56 degrees Fahrenheit. Upon inspection of the delivery truck, the leafy greens were not held in cold holding equipment. PIC immediately placed the spinach in the milk chest cooler to rapidly cool. Driver was made aware that all food items are to be properly held in cold holding and/or hot holding equipment during transportation to schools. New Violation. Correct By: 09/26/2024
